select
    incoming.customer_id,
    incoming.customer_name,
    incoming.email,
    incoming.country,
    incoming.segment,
    incoming.signup_date,
    incoming.is_deleted,
    incoming.slr_updated_at,
    current_timestamp() as dim_ingested_time,
    current_timestamp() as dim_updated_time
from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`slr_customers` as incoming

left join `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`dim_customers` as existing
    on incoming.customer_id = existing.customer_id
where existing.customer_id is null
   or incoming.slr_updated_at > existing.slr_updated_at

select
    incoming.order_id,
    incoming.customer_id,
    incoming.amount,
    incoming.status,
    incoming.source_inserted_at,
    incoming.source_updated_at,
    incoming.slr_updated_at
from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`slr_orders` as incoming

left join `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`fact_orders` as existing
    on incoming.order_id = existing.order_id
where existing.order_id is null
   or incoming.slr_updated_at > existing.slr_updated_at

with customers as (
    select *,
        count(*) over (partition by customer_id) as customer_id_count,
        count(*) over (partition by email) as email_count
    from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`dim_customers`
)
-- Any rows returned are invalid and fail the test.
select *
from customers
where
    -- Required dimension values.
    customer_id is null
    or customer_name is null
    or email is null
    or country is null
    or segment is null
    or signup_date is null
    or is_deleted is null
    or dim_ingested_time is null
    or dim_updated_time is null
    or slr_updated_at is null

    -- One current row per customer; emails must also be unique.
    or customer_id_count > 1
    or email_count > 1

    -- Allowed customer segments and processing timestamp order.
    or segment not in ('STANDARD', 'PREMIUM')
    or dim_updated_time < dim_ingested_time

with orders as (
    select *,
        count(*) over (partition by order_id) as order_id_count
    from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`fact_orders`
)
-- Any rows returned are invalid and fail the test.
select *
from orders
where
    -- Required fact values.
    order_id is null
    or customer_id is null
    or amount is null
    or status is null
    or source_inserted_at is null
    or source_updated_at is null
    or slr_updated_at is null

    -- One current row per order.
    or order_id_count > 1

    -- Allowed order statuses and amount range.
    or status not in ('PLACED', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED', 'REFUNDED')
    or amount < 0
    or amount > 100000

    -- Every order must reference a customer in the Gold dimension.
    -- Soft-deleted customers remain valid relationship targets.
    or not exists (
        select 1
        from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`dim_customers` as customers
        where customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id
    )

with order_summary as (
    select
        customer_id,
        count(*) as total_orders,
        count(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end) as completed_orders,
        cast(sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then amount else 0 end)
            as decimal(28,2)) as completed_sales_amount,
        count(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 end) as cancelled_orders,
        count(case when status = 'REFUNDED' then 1 end) as refunded_orders,
        max(source_inserted_at) as latest_order_at
    from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`fact_orders`
    group by customer_id
)

select
    customers.customer_id,
    customers.customer_name,
    customers.country,
    customers.segment,
    coalesce(orders.total_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as total_orders,
    coalesce(orders.completed_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as completed_orders,
    coalesce(orders.completed_sales_amount, cast(0 as decimal(28,2)))
        as completed_sales_amount,
    coalesce(orders.cancelled_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as cancelled_orders,
    coalesce(orders.refunded_orders, cast(0 as bigint)) as refunded_orders,
    orders.latest_order_at
from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`dim_customers` as customers
left join order_summary as orders
    on customers.customer_id = orders.customer_id

select
    cast(source_inserted_at as date) as order_date,
    count(*) as total_orders,
    count(case when status = 'PLACED' then 1 end) as placed_orders,
    count(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 end) as completed_orders,
    cast(sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then amount else 0 end)
        as decimal(28,2)) as completed_sales_amount,
    count(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then 1 end) as cancelled_orders,
    cast(sum(case when status = 'CANCELLED' then amount else 0 end)
        as decimal(28,2)) as cancelled_order_amount,
    count(case when status = 'REFUNDED' then 1 end) as refunded_orders,
    cast(sum(case when status = 'REFUNDED' then amount else 0 end)
        as decimal(28,2)) as refunded_order_amount
from `retail_analytics_poc_strm_tab`.`dbt_retail_streaming_poc`.`fact_orders`
group by cast(source_inserted_at as date)
